title: The Mushroom Cellar
text: Slick steps lead down into the cellar of a ruined house, where a field of mushrooms glows soft blue and green in the dark. Healers and alchemists prize them, and they are very beautiful. The rats down here are very large and very calm.

options.label: Pick the glowing mushrooms; healers and alchemists pay dearly for them.

outcomes.text: You carry out baskets of soft light while the rats watch.
Spores burst in a pale cloud. The cellar starts to tilt.

options.label: The toughest eats one to see what the healers see.

outcomes.text: Visions come, then clarity. The road ahead lies laid out like a map.
Visions come, then vomiting, then worse.

options.label: Take spores home to grow the light in the dark beneath your own House.

outcomes.text: The crop takes under the House's floors. The cellar smells of it for years.
